gloss: bar district; drinking quarter; street of bars

definitions.gloss: bar district; drinking quarter; street of bars
definitions.explanation: An area or street concentrated with bars, izakaya, and other drinking establishments. A characteristic feature of Japanese urban nightlife.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}をぶらぶら{歩|ある}く。
examples.english: To stroll around the bar district.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くに{飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}がある。
examples.english: There is a bar district near the station.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}{帰|がえ}りに{同僚|どうりょう}と{飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}に{繰|く}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: After work, I headed out to the bar district with my colleagues.

notes:
A compound of {飲|の}み{屋|や} (bar, drinking establishment) and {街|がい} (district, quarter). Japanese cities typically have well-defined {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい} areas near train stations, often featuring narrow alleys lined with small bars and izakaya. Famous examples include {新宿|しんじゅく}ゴールデン{街|がい} and {思|おも}い{出|で}{横丁|よこちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}に{出|で}かける: to go out to the bar district
- {飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}で{飲|の}む: to drink in the bar district
- {駅前|えきまえ}の{飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}: the bar district in front of the station
- {昭和|しょうわ}レトロな{飲|の}み{屋街|やがい}: a retro Showa-era bar district

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繁華街|はんかがい}: entertainment district — a broader term that includes shops, restaurants, and other entertainment, not just drinking
- {歓楽街|かんらくがい}: pleasure quarter — a nightlife and entertainment district, sometimes with adult-oriented establishments
- {横丁|よこちょう}: side street, alley — a narrow lane, often lined with small bars and eateries
